annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive for resolvers to treat Additional section records in SVCB-compatible responses with SOURCE PREFIX-LENGTH zero and SCOPE PREFIX-LENGTH as per the ECS option. There is no ambiguity in the behavior it prescribes, as it aligns with the referenced standard (RFC 7871) and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations.
